from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class UniversityData(BaseModel):
    """Raw institutional data required to calculate the Faculty Investment Index and rank graduation rates."""
    university_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the university")
    full_time_instructional_faculty: float | None = Field(description="Count of full-time instructional faculty")
    part_time_instructional_faculty: float | None = Field(description="Count of part-time instructional faculty")
    total_student_enrollment: float | None = Field(description="Total student enrollment")
    graduation_rate_2015_cohort: float | None = Field(description="Six-year graduation rate for Fall 2015 cohort")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    universities: list[UniversityData]
